text: Companies that adopt unmediated and technology-driven governance gain a competitive advantage in attracting talent, raising capital, finding partners, and above all in remaining relevant in hyper-competitive global markets.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176

isBasedOn.name: The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies

abstract: Today's successful companies embrace these insights and therefore have a competitive advantage in attracting talent, raising capital, finding suitable partners, and, perhaps most importantly, in remaining relevant in hyper-competitive global markets.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: hyper-competitive global markets shaped by social media, blockchain, DAOs and artificial intelligence
